The registered `final-core-combined-qualification.yml` workflow has two Darwin scientific selections. `scientific-darwin-tool-baseline` records the runner tools. `scientific-installed-darwin-observation` observes a complete accepted Darwin arm64 package through a private installation. Both selections use `scientific_observation_binding` as one JSON string and the exact published observer commit as the dispatch ref.

For the tool baseline, fill `tool-baseline-binding-template.json` with that observer commit. The registered inputs `product_run_id` and `product_run_attempt` are unused in this selection; supply `0` and `1`. The job selects Node 22.23.3 with the pinned setup action. It downloads Chrome 155.0.8059.39 for mac-arm64 from the exact URL in the retained official Chrome for Testing metadata. It records the full metadata, archive, extracted files, executable sizes and SHA256, executable realpaths and stat fields, architecture, full version streams and natural statuses, account, operating system, workflow and helper source, raw dispatch input, and pinned action identities. It runs each tool's `--version` after recording all three tools' bytes and architecture. The Python interpreter that starts the helper is a runner bootstrap dependency whose actual identity is retained.

The baseline artifact contains `baseline-result.json` and `tool-bindings.json`. Root reviews the actual result and artifact provenance before using those values in the installed observer binding. The baseline downloads no native artifact, installs no Baton payload, creates no native actors or database, and starts no CDP browser session. Its source preparation remains held until Root authorizes the exact dispatch.

For installed observation, fill `binding-template.json` from accepted evidence. The binding identifies the published observer commit, package producer run/attempt/job, full artifact ID/digest, archive and sidecars, Darwin executable, retained C, Linux Main result, and complete nine-suite evidence. It includes accepted baseline run/attempt/artifact/result provenance and exact Node, Python, Chrome archive and Chrome executable identities. Python version is its complete `--version` output, such as `Python 3.13.7`; Node version omits the initial `v`. Unknown bindings keep the gate held. The observer verifies tool bytes and architecture before version commands, package download or private installation. Changed tool bytes refuse observation.

The runner downloads the full package artifact by ID and verifies its digest against the accepted GitHub artifact metadata. It extracts the complete package with the immutable product smoke extractor, preserves its manifest and notices, and creates a command symlink under a fresh private HOME. Retained package provenance and the artifact's complete C form a separate verification tree for the unchanged retained-C helper. The nine-suite plan and full streams remain bound to the original Main source and native.

The Reading and Numeric inputs are preserved bytes from their accepted scientific scenarios. Each flow uses its own database, actor workspaces, Chrome profile and short private runtime. The drivers invoke the installed public CLI and ordinary native view server, retain raw CLI/HTTP/SSE responses and wide/390px browser evidence, and settle only their owned browser, view and instance processes. The runner compares the complete installed payload before and after these observations. The immutable product checkout supplies independent expected bytes and the exact installed UI file set.

The native view uses the ordinary system `open` path. The runner retains dispatch spools and before/after process and LaunchServices observations. The product discards the `Control.launch` result containing the opener PID. These observations cannot reconstruct that PID or establish default-browser tab settlement. The runner performs no lifecycle action on that application. Owned CDP process settlement and default-browser effects are separate recorded boundaries.

All generated evidence, complete installed payload, raw streams, source binding and original full artifact remain in the uploaded observation artifact. Root reviews this source and actual package/tool bindings before authorizing an observation dispatch. Existing retained-C, package and runtime selections retain their prior source and eligibility.
